u0: The task is underway and the box may be in hand or already dropped; the exit has not been reached. The agent must get to the exit while carrying the box, and every time the box slips out of its hands it must pick the box up again before finishing. Reaching the exit while the box is still held completes the task, whereas reaching the exit with empty hands leaves the fallen box outstanding and only a later pickup can still satisfy the requirement.
u1: The box has just fallen out of the agent's hands and has not yet been picked up. To recover, the agent must pick the box up again, which returns it to the normal carrying situation; the exit still must be reached with the box in hand. Going to the exit while the box is still on the floor leaves the pickup requirement unmet and the task incomplete.
u2: The exit has been reached with the box in the agent's hands, so the requirement to arrive carrying the box and the requirement to recover every fallen box are both satisfied. The task is complete.
u3: The agent stands on the exit but is not holding the box, so the box has been left behind and the pickup requirement is still outstanding. The task is not complete; the agent must pick the box up again to satisfy the requirement. Only once the box is back in hand does the task count as finished.
